ai_features.name: X9 Machine Learning Model (AV fistula/graft vessel detection and localization)
ai_features.function: ML model on B-mode images determines whether a hemodialysis access vessel (arteriovenous fistula/graft) is visible and estimates its lateral location to guide handpiece alignment prior to cannulation. Validation: 378 images from 63 AVF/G participants; Access Presence Sensitivity 94.5% (criterion >=75%), mean lateral error 0.492 mm (criterion <=3 mm), mean Dice 81.3% (criterion >=75%).
ai_features.quote: A Machine Learning Model Validation was performed to confirm that the ML model correctly determined if an access vessel was visible and if the average lateral error between the ML Model and the access vessel True Location was acceptable.

records.exclusion_reason: Only AI/ML feature is vascular-access (AV fistula/graft) vessel detection for dialysis cannulation guidance; indications are limited to vascular access imaging and the device has no cardiac application (IFU p.4; ML validation pp.7-8).

ai_features.name: AI-1: High-Level Anatomy Classification
ai_features.function: Multi-label classification of the general fetal anatomical region in a 2D fetal ultrasound image (head/brain, face, thorax/chest ('Heart Screening Planes'), abdomen, limbs). Standalone testing on 11,186 images / 296 patients: 'Heart Screening' plane detection sensitivity 0.912 (95% CI 0.895-0.928), specificity 0.990.
ai_features.quote: BioticsAI uses artificial intelligence (A.I.) to automatically annotate ultrasound images with fetal anatomical planes and structures to facilitate ultrasound review and report generation for fetal ultrasound anatomical scans.

ai_features.name: AI-2: Per-Class Top-1 Fetal Plane Classification
ai_features.function: Classifies 13 standard ISUOG/AIUM mid-trimester fetal planes (abdomen, face, head, heart 4-chamber, femur, sagittal spine) and picks the top-1 image per plane. thorax_lungs_four_heart_chambers sensitivity 0.969, specificity 0.997.
ai_features.quote: Provides fetal anatomical plane classifications using a per-class Top-1 approach. A fetal "plane" refers to a standardized cross-sectional view defined by ISUOG and aligned with AIUM guidance for mid-trimester fetal anatomy scans.

ai_features.name: AI-3: Fetal Anatomical Structure Classification
ai_features.function: Multi-label detection of fetal anatomical structures within supported planes, including 16 fetal thorax/heart structures (LV, RV, LA, RA, ventricular septum, LVOT, RVOT, aorta, pulmonary artery, SVC, etc.) on 4-chamber, LVOT, RVOT, 3VV, 3VT planes to support quality-criteria verification. Sensitivity 0.978 on diagnostically acceptable images, specificity 0.989 for thorax/heart structures.
ai_features.quote: Automatic detection of 16 fetal thorax and heart anatomical structures on the views "Four Chamber", "LVOT", "RVOT", "3VV", "3VT" 0.978 (0.969, 0.985) 0.925 (0.911, 0.939) 0.989 (0.988, 0.99)

records.exclusion_reason: Fetal (OB) anatomy-scan AI: detects fetal planes and structures as a concurrent reading aid for fetal ultrasound (IFU p.4). The only cardiac content is detection of fetal heart screening planes (4CH, LVOT, RVOT, 3VV, 3VT) and fetal cardiac structures within a mid-trimester OB anatomy scan; this is fetal anatomy screening, not echocardiography, and provides no cardiac function/measurement output. Borderline; flagged in notes.

ai_features.name: DEEPECHO fetal biometry view detection and measurement
ai_features.function: Machine-learning detection of standard fetal biometry views (cephalic, abdominal, femoral) on 2D fetal ultrasound and automatic caliper placement/measurement of HC, BPD, AC, FL with derived GA and EFW; cloud SaMD, real-time view detection via HDMI capture. Standalone test: 397 subjects / 23,544 images from 15 sites; view sensitivity 86.9% (abdominal), 98.2% (cephalic), 91.8% (femoral); Deming regression slopes 0.969-1.026 for FL/HC/AC/BPD vs three sonographers.
ai_features.quote: DEEPECHO is intended to analyze fetal ultrasound images and clips using machine learning techniques to detect standard biometry views. Upon views detection, DEEPECHO assists in measurements computation of fetal biometric parameters (i.e., head circumference, abdominal circumference, femur length, and bi-parietal diameter).

records.exclusion_reason: Despite the product name, DEEPECHO is fetal (OB) biometry software: it detects cephalic, abdominal, and femoral views and measures HC/BPD/AC/FL. No cardiac view, structure, or measurement is detected or output (comparison table p.8 lists views as Cephalic, Abdominal, Femoral only).

notes: All seven FDA summary text files were read in full; no web search was used, every decision is grounded in the FDA text. Decision dates and device names are from openfda_records.json. Page numbers refer to the '===== PAGE n =====' markers (PDF page numbers, including the cover letter). Key judgment calls: (1) K253716 and K253720 are the only two Ks with cardiac AI; United Imaging explicitly places Auto EF/Fast EF and uWorks Echo under 'Summary of the Machine Learning Algorithm' with quantitative test results, while Fast Strain/2D Strain, Auto WMA, 4D MVQ and 4D LAAQ are cardiac automated features whose ML basis is not stated. Because the predicate is GE LOGIQ E10 and references are GE Vivid, Philips EPIQ, Voluson and Mindray Consona, all uSONIQUE features are new to this manufacturer's US clearance (introduced_in_this_k=true), though they are positioned as equivalents of already-cleared competitor features. K253716 test data were acquired on uSONIQUE Genesis; K253720 on uSONIQUE Nova. (2) K250959 BioticsAI is borderline: its AI detects fetal heart screening planes (4CH, LVOT, RVOT, 3VV, 3VT) and 16 fetal cardiac structures, with reported sensitivity/specificity, but this is a mid-trimester OB anatomy screening aid with no cardiac function or measurement output; classified as not cardiac echocardiography AI. Reclassify if the registry scope includes fetal cardiac screening plane detection. (3) K241949 SonoScape P60: Auto EF is listed as a migrated auto measurement from K222596/K221140 and is not described as AI/ML; the only feature the summary identifies as AI/ML is S-FetusAI (fetal). (4) K242594 DEEPECHO is fetal biometry only despite the 'echo' name. (5) K181574 Uscan has no AI/ML wording; its automated bladder volume feature was also present in the K160420 predicate ('Distance, volume calculations'), so introduced_in_this_k=false. (6) K251673 X9 is an ML vascular-access localization device with no cardiac scope.
